title: The Venv Ritual, In Order
prompt: Write a function venv_steps() that returns the exact shell commands to (1) create a venv named .venv and (2) activate it on macOS/Linux — as a list of two strings, in that order.

tests.name: commands in order
tests.code:
steps = venv_steps()
assert steps == ["python3 -m venv .venv", "source .venv/bin/activate"], f"got {steps}"
assert "venv" in steps[0] and "activate" in steps[1], "create before activate"
